purpose_statement: Evaluate supplier quotes, compare pricing tiers, and generate vendor purchase order drafts under $1,000. Strictly bounded to vendor catalog lookups and purchasing workflows.

authorized_tools.name: search_vendor_catalog
authorized_tools.description: Search approved vendor product catalog and unit pricing
example_prompts: Find approved office supply vendors in Northeast region

authorized_tools.name: create_po_draft
authorized_tools.description: Create a preliminary purchase order draft for approval under $1,000
example_prompts: Draft PO for 20 ergonomics keyboards at $85 each
